Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com 'unsafe-inline'; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://formspree.io; form-action 'self' https://formspree.io; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'
Content-Security-Policy-Meta: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com 'unsafe-inline'; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://formspree.io; form-action 'self' https://formspree.io; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'
_comment: Content-Security-Policy is sent as an HTTP response header by the test server (scripts/*.test.cjs). Content-Security-Policy-Meta is embedded as a <meta http-equiv> tag on every page for production, because GitHub Pages cannot set response headers; it is identical minus frame-ancestors, which browsers ignore in meta delivery. scripts/csp-probe.cjs verifies every page runs clean under both.
